entries.description: kihugho ekyakalhwiramo kutse abuthirwemo
entries.subject: kihugho ekyakalhwiramo

spans.text: Buli puyima awithe obuthoki eribya nobuholho obukabughawako omo kisango kino ahathe erighabaniamo lyomuhanda wosiwosi eriseghemera ngokobinu; oko rangi eyolhuhwe lhwiwe, oko mubughe wiwe, oko kihanda ekyobubuthiranwa bwiwe, oko kihugho ekyakalhwiramo kutse abuthirwemo, oko malengekania wiwe awemibere eyobyobuthabali, omo lhughanda alwakabuthawamo, nimukali kuse nimulhume, nimutheke kutse nimunaku, nimutheke omoby'ekisomo ekyamenge kutse syalyathalholha omo kitabo kyosikyosi, nebindi ebisosene ngebyo sibirilhusaya mundu wosi kw'obuholho bwiwe nimukyanabya ekitsumbi kiwe.

entries.subject: nimutheke

entries.task_id: muliki buyirayira|kutse|erithibithwako akahulhukibwa eyihya ye kihugho kyewabo (exile)
entries.description: muliki buyirayira kutse erithibithwako akahulhukibwa eyihya ye kihugho kyewabo (exile)
entries.subject: muliki buyirayira
entries.object: erithibithwako akahulhukibwa eyihya ye kihugho kyewabo (exile)

spans.text: Sihali mundu wosiwosi eyowangahambwa akathwalibwa omo muliki buyirayira (Arbitrary arrests) kutse erithibithwako akahulhukibwa eyihya ye kihugho kyewabo (exile), mulyanabya erimukingira omo muliki molhughumerere butsira thongana omo kyaghanda kyebihano ebyekihugho kiwe.

entries.task_id: ekithawithe ihuhande|kutse|kasolholho
entries.description: ekithawithe Ihuhande kutse kasolholho
entries.subject: ekithawithe Ihuhande

spans.text: Buli mundu nuwabuholho, ahathe erisolholha, erikiriribwa eriyithonganira oko Ihubanza Ihosi olhukamubiribawako, embere sye'kyaghanda ekyasibwe ngekyabalekya ekithawithe Ihuhande kutse kasolholho.

entries.task_id: oko ihubanza|kutse|erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa
entries.description: oko Ihubanza kutse erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa
entries.subject: oko Ihubanza

spans.text: Neryo ekyathoka erimulekya oko Ihubanza kutse erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa, eryalyakolha nerithwa ebihano ngokobiri omokisakango ekyekyaghanda eky'ekihugho ekyo kutse eky'ekikugho ebihindahindene ekyahamulha ekisakango kino.

entries.task_id: eky'ekihugho ekyo|kutse|eky'ekikugho ebihindahindene ekyahamulha ekisakango kino
entries.description: eky'ekihugho ekyo kutse eky'ekikugho ebihindahindene ekyahamulha ekisakango kino
entries.subject: eky'ekihugho ekyo

spans.text: Neryo ekyathoka erimulekya oko Ihubanza kutse erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa, eryalyakolha nerithwa ebihano ngokobiri omokisakango ekyekyaghanda eky'ekihugho ekyo kutse eky'ekikugho ebihindahindene ekyahamulha ekisakango kino.

Sihali mundu namuyima eyotholere erighanzwa ngoyowithe olhubanza kutse ngomunyamuliki, kandi neryaghalibwa esyongebe siwe, nibya ekikamwaghalisaya isikyabya kyerimuhira omolhubanza Ihungana nolho, omomughulhu kyakolerawamo, omomighanza eyebihano ebyomukyaghanda ekyabalekya eky'ekihugho kiwe kutse eky'ebugho ebihindahindene ngokobyasibwe ehosi.

entries.task_id: awithe olhubanza|kutse|erilholho eriakumbughawako indi akolire
entries.description: awithe olhubanza kutse erilholho eriakumbughawako indi akolire
entries.subject: awithe olhubanza

spans.text: Buli mundu wosi amabya indi awithe olhubanza kutse erilholho eriakumbughawako indi akolire, kandi iryangamukolya okwighalibwa omongebe siwe nerimubohesya omo nyumba yomuliki, awithe obuholho eririndwa kutse erimutsunga ng'oyotheko Ihubanza erikolya ebihano ahobikendimulhumanirya omo kyaghanda ekyabalekya.

entries.task_id: omo myatsi|kutse|omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe
entries.description: omo myatsi kutse omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe
entries.subject: omo myatsi
entries.object: omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe

spans.text: Sihale namuyima eyowithe obuthoki, nomubwanabya obusinga, eyowangayingirya omo myatsi kutse omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe; omuyi wiwe, kutse mwatse wahe owakahambangana oko byesyombitha siwe nga; ahakakesaya, ebisakango byiwe kutse eryanza erimutsandirya erina liwe, ekitsumbi kiwe, mulyanabya erimuhemulikania omo bandu.

Buli mundu niwabuholho erihuma omo kihugho kutse omo kipindi, nimukyanginabya inikihugho kyewabo, erighenda nerisondya ohwakakwa muhwa eribya kutse erighenda erisaba obwikalho omo kihugho ekindi ekyanginamwikirirya erimuhabo.

entries.subject: Hamabyaho erithibithwako

spans.text: Hamabyaho erithibithwako (Persecution) kutse erihima oko mundu wosi wosi, akabya inyawithe obuholho omo kihugho ekyanga enyanzire erisabamo obwikalho, neriberamo wabwiranda omwekyo ekyabiryanza, nerikiriribwa eribyamukyo.

folded.id: ngoyowithe olhubanza|kutse|ngomunyamuliki
folded.subject: ngoyowithe olhubanza

spans.text: Sihali mundu namuyima eyotholere erighanzwa ngoyowithe olhubanza kutse ngomunyamuliki, kandi neryaghalibwa esyongebe siwe, nibya ekikamwaghalisaya isikyabya kyerimuhira omolhubanza Ihungana nolho, omomughulhu kyakolerawamo, omomighanza eyebihano ebyomukyaghanda ekyabalekya eky'ekihugho kiwe kutse eky'ebugho ebihindahindene ngokobyasibwe ehosi.

folded.id: nimutheke|kutse|nimunaku
folded.subject: nimutheke

spans.text: Buli puyima awithe obuthoki eribya nobuholho obukabughawako omo kisango kino ahathe erighabaniamo lyomuhanda wosiwosi eriseghemera ngokobinu; oko rangi eyolhuhwe lhwiwe, oko mubughe wiwe, oko kihanda ekyobubuthiranwa bwiwe, oko kihugho ekyakalhwiramo kutse abuthirwemo, oko malengekania wiwe awemibere eyobyobuthabali, omo lhughanda alwakabuthawamo, nimukali kuse nimulhume, nimutheke kutse nimunaku, nimutheke omoby'ekisomo ekyamenge kutse syalyathalholha omo kitabo kyosikyosi, nebindi ebisosene ngebyo sibirilhusaya mundu wosi kw'obuholho bwiwe nimukyanabya ekitsumbi kiwe.

folded.id: obuholho eririndwa|kutse|erimutsunga ng'oyotheko ihubanza erikolya ebihano ahobikendimulhumanirya omo kyaghanda ekyabalekya
folded.subject: obuholho eririndwa
folded.object: erimutsunga ng'oyotheko Ihubanza erikolya ebihano ahobikendimulhumanirya omo kyaghanda ekyabalekya

spans.text: Buli mundu wosi amabya indi awithe olhubanza kutse erilholho eriakumbughawako indi akolire, kandi iryangamukolya okwighalibwa omongebe siwe nerimubohesya omo nyumba yomuliki, awithe obuholho eririndwa kutse erimutsunga ng'oyotheko Ihubanza erikolya ebihano ahobikendimulhumanirya omo kyaghanda ekyabalekya.

folded.id: obuthoki|kutse|obuholho obo
folded.subject: Obuthoki

spans.text: Obuthoki kutse obuholho obo, sibwangalhusibwa oko mundu busana neribya indi awithe olhubanza busana nerithwa ebihano ebyanulikaghulhu (Common Law) kutse emibere eyabuli kaghulhu eyomukihugho ekyo.

folded.id: oko ihubanza|kutse|erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa
folded.subject: oko Ihubanza

spans.text: Neryo ekyathoka erimulekya oko Ihubanza kutse erilholho eryalyakolha erikaghanibawa, eryalyakolha nerithwa ebihano ngokobiri omokisakango ekyekyaghanda eky'ekihugho ekyo kutse eky'ekikugho ebihindahindene ekyahamulha ekisakango kino.

folded.id: omo myatsi|kutse|omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe
folded.subject: omo myatsi
folded.object: omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe

spans.text: Sihale namuyima eyowithe obuthoki, nomubwanabya obusinga, eyowangayingirya omo myatsi kutse omo bindu byamundu wosi wosi ebiri omo maboko kutse omo buthoki bwiwe thubughe; omuyi wiwe, kutse mwatse wahe owakahambangana oko byesyombitha siwe nga; ahakakesaya, ebisakango byiwe kutse eryanza erimutsandirya erina liwe, ekitsumbi kiwe, mulyanabya erimuhemulikania omo bandu.

Buli mundu niwabuholho erihuma omo kihugho kutse omo kipindi, nimukyanginabya inikihugho kyewabo, erighenda nerisondya ohwakakwa muhwa eribya kutse erighenda erisaba obwikalho omo kihugho ekindi ekyanginamwikirirya erimuhabo.

folded.id: omoby'ekisomo ekyamenge|kutse|syalyathalholha omo kitabo kyosikyosi
folded.subject: omoby'ekisomo ekyamenge

spans.text: Buli puyima awithe obuthoki eribya nobuholho obukabughawako omo kisango kino ahathe erighabaniamo lyomuhanda wosiwosi eriseghemera ngokobinu; oko rangi eyolhuhwe lhwiwe, oko mubughe wiwe, oko kihanda ekyobubuthiranwa bwiwe, oko kihugho ekyakalhwiramo kutse abuthirwemo, oko malengekania wiwe awemibere eyobyobuthabali, omo lhughanda alwakabuthawamo, nimukali kuse nimulhume, nimutheke kutse nimunaku, nimutheke omoby'ekisomo ekyamenge kutse syalyathalholha omo kitabo kyosikyosi, nebindi ebisosene ngebyo sibirilhusaya mundu wosi kw'obuholho bwiwe nimukyanabya ekitsumbi kiwe.
